allowed.reason: ChromaDB HTTP-server RCE is unreachable: zk-chat uses only the embedded PersistentClient and does not start chromadb.server. Re-verified 2026-09-20: chromadb 1.5.9 is still the latest release on PyPI and OSV records it as `last_affected`, so no patched version exists to upgrade to. (see chroma-core/chroma advisory GHSA-f4j7-r4q5-qw2c, tracked by pip-audit as PYSEC-2026-311).

Cross-tenant authorization bypass requires an authenticated ChromaDB HTTP server with multi-tenant RBAC enabled. zk-chat uses only the embedded PersistentClient and never starts chromadb.server, so this attack surface does not exist. Re-verified 2026-09-20: chromadb 1.5.9 is still the latest release on PyPI and OSV records it as `last_affected`, so no patched version exists to upgrade to. (see chroma-core/chroma advisory GHSA-2wm9-hf6c-p5cr).

Code injection via a malicious model repository requires the ChromaDB HTTP server, an authenticated attacker with UPDATE_COLLECTION permission, and trust_remote_code=true. zk-chat uses only the embedded PersistentClient, never starts chromadb.server, and never sets trust_remote_code. Re-verified 2026-09-20: chromadb 1.5.9 is still the latest release on PyPI and OSV records it as `last_affected`, so no patched version exists to upgrade to. (see chroma-core/chroma advisory GHSA-36p7-vc44-83pf).

SimpleRBACAuthorizationProvider's missing tenant/database/collection scoping is only exploitable against an authenticated ChromaDB HTTP server with RBAC enabled. zk-chat uses only the embedded PersistentClient and never starts chromadb.server, so this attack surface does not exist. Re-verified 2026-09-20: chromadb 1.5.9 is still the latest release on PyPI and OSV records it as `last_affected`, so no patched version exists to upgrade to. (see chroma-core/chroma advisory GHSA-xph7-9rjv-w5fr).
